journey.description: Baha Turk begins its journey in Turkey.
Technical knowledge, construction expertise, and modern methods become central to our approach.
Baha Turk enters Afghanistan with a vision to contribute to modern construction and urban development.
Our first and largest project in Afghanistan brings our engineering approach to the heart of Kabul.
Our ambition is to expand into larger developments and introduce advanced construction technologies.

projects.title: Solh Residential Project
projects.subtitle: Modern Engineering. Lasting Quality. A Better Future.
projects.summary: Located in Makroyan 5, Kabul, Solh Residential Project is Baha Turk's first and largest project in Afghanistan. Developed in cooperation with the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing, the project aims to create a modern, safe, and well-planned residential community...

engineering.title: Strength Begins Below the Surface.
engineering.description: The strength of Solh Residential Project begins with its foundation. Each building is constructed on 96 piles extending approximately 20 meters into the ground...
engineering.technology_description: One of the defining features of Solh Residential Project is the use of the Tunnel Form System, introduced by Baha Turk in Afghanistan for the first time...

safety.description: Safety is a fundamental priority in the design and construction of Solh Residential Project. Through its integrated structural system and engineering approach, the structural system is designed for resistance of up to 10 on the Richter scale.

location_mapping.title: A Prime Location in Makroyan 5
location_mapping.description: Solh Residential Project is located in Makroyan 5, Kabul, with convenient access to the city's important destinations.

legal_assurance.title: Ownership Built on Confidence.
legal_assurance.description: Official Sharia Deeds for residential units are issued through the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing. The Ministry is responsible for land acquisition, urban planning, technical supervision, plan processing, and approval, while the full implementation of the project is carried out by Baha Turk Construction Company.
